blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte confirmed on Tuesday that he knows and has business ties with Jaime Tan Cruz. He made the confirmation on the 31st day of the impeachment trial of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte, when he sat as a hostile witness for the prosecution. Mayor Duterte was asked by private prosecutor Theodore Te if he knew Jaime T. Cruz. “Yes,” the mayor replied. Te then asked whether Mayor Duterte knew Cruz because they had business dealings together. The mayor again answered in the affirmative. READ: Watch: Baste Duterte says he only learned about […]...
